title: Striped Tank & Denim Lounge
prompt: An original young woman with wavy, sun-kissed blonde hair sits on a white couch with her knees drawn up. She wears a red-and-white striped tank top with a small bow detail and light wash straight-leg denim jeans. Red chunky platform sandals complete the look. Her expression is calm, looking straight at the camera. Warm, golden indoor light and a plain beige wall behind her. Palette of cream, denim blue, and cherry red. Relaxed and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s lifestyle photo.
workingNotes:
- The red sandals and striped tank create the color accents.
- Keep the warm light for a sunny, relaxed feel.
